name: Studies of two Chinese blacksmiths working beneath a sunshade, and of a Chinese man in wet-weather dress
summary: Beneath the blacksmiths' sunshade the standing figure hammers at his anvil; to his left is a furnace and cylindrical bellows.  For other drawings in the V&A collection of figures in wet-weather dress see E.2127-1921 and E.1628-1928.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
